signature.name: VTask.comp
signature.type: {α : Type u} -> {β : Type v} -> {γ : Type w} -> [TopologicalSpace α] -> [PseudoMetricSpace β] -> [PseudoMetricSpace γ] -> (G : β → γ) -> {C : NNReal} -> (H : LipschitzWith C G) -> (f : BoundedContinuousFunction α β) -> BoundedContinuousFunction α γ

conventions.statement: When the Lipschitz constant C is 0, G is a constant map, and VTask.comp G H f is the corresponding constant bounded continuous function with bound 0.
conventions.note: NNReal ensures C is always non-negative; C = 0 is the minimal admissible value.

facts.statement: ∀ {α : Type*} {β : Type*} {γ : Type*} [TopologicalSpace α] [PseudoMetricSpace β] [PseudoMetricSpace γ] (G : β → γ) {C : NNReal} (H : LipschitzWith C G), LipschitzWith C (VTask.comp G H : BoundedContinuousFunction α β → BoundedContinuousFunction α γ)
